summary: A restore fails if the new AutomationController name matches an existing deployment, since PVCs and Secrets remain; delete the AutomationController and its postgres-13-<name>-13-0 PVC, then apply the AutomationControllerRestore.
questions: Restore fails because the AutomationController name already exists
How do I reuse a controller deployment name for a restore?
Delete the postgres PVC before restoring controller

answer_card.title: Restore with the same name
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
oc delete automationcontroller <YOUR_DEPLOYMENT_NAME> -n <YOUR_NAMESPACE>
oc delete pvc postgres-13-<YOUR_DEPLOYMENT_NAME>-13-0 -n <YOUR_NAMESPACE>
oc apply -f restore.yaml   # AutomationControllerRestore with the same deployment_name
```
